// Referência do benchmark.
import { getBlock, WOODEN_PICKAXE, STONE_PICKAXE } from './blocks.js'

const isPickaxe = t => t === WOODEN_PICKAXE || t === STONE_PICKAXE

export function canHarvest(blockId, toolId) {
  const tool = getBlock(blockId).tool
  if (tool === null) return true
  if (tool === 'pickaxe') return isPickaxe(toolId)
  return toolId === STONE_PICKAXE
}

export function breakTime(blockId, toolId) {
  const block = getBlock(blockId)
  if (block.hardness === Infinity) return Infinity
  const speed = block.tool !== null && isPickaxe(toolId) ? (toolId === STONE_PICKAXE ? 4 : 2) : 1
  return (block.hardness * (canHarvest(blockId, toolId) ? 1.5 : 5)) / speed
}

export function dropsFor(blockId, toolId) {
  const drop = getBlock(blockId).drop
  return drop !== null && canHarvest(blockId, toolId) ? [{ id: drop, count: 1 }] : []
}
